licence.renewsTogether.value: The lease can be renewed in the same service request when it has under 90 days left or has expired. Needed to renew: audited financial statements, valid licences, permits, visas and approvals, no arrears on the lease, workmen's compensation insurance for active employees, third party liability insurance for physical units, and operational fitness certificates. Whether the establishment card renews in the same step is unknown.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), DMCC, renews together (DMCC Licence Renewal Guidelines; Licensing Rules 3.3.3(a), (b) and (c); CONFIRMED); https://dmcc.ae/members/support/knowledge-bank/licence-renewal-guidelines ; https://dmcc.ae/hubfs/Compliance%20Documents%202024/Licensing%20Rules-%20Final.pdf?hsLang=ar

licence.afterExpiry.value: No business may be carried on without a valid licence. If the licence is not renewed by expiry, the Registrar may at its discretion allow a limited grace period to finish renewal; its length is not stated. If renewal is not done within that period, the licence may be suspended or terminated by written notice, effective on the date in the notice, and a sanction or strike-off is possible. A sanction goes on the member account and penalties apply. The lease late renewal penalty starts from the lease expiry date. No fixed day threshold for suspension or strike-off was found.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), DMCC, late renewal (DMCC Licensing Rules 3.3.2, 3.3.4, Rule 5 and 5.4, and the Licence Renewal Guidelines, CONFIRMED. CONFLICT: the existing licence.lateRenewalFine value (Boasis research, licence lifecycle, section 5) gives a day ladder ending in termination after 90 days; the DMCC rules read on 2026-09-28 state no fixed day threshold. Both kept; verify with DMCC); https://dmcc.ae/members/support/knowledge-bank/licence-renewal-guidelines ; https://dmcc.ae/hubfs/Compliance%20Documents%202024/Licensing%20Rules-%20Final.pdf?hsLang=ar
